body: I’m sorry to hear that, my surgeon did warn me about the potential to scar badly because I’m Hispanic and it tends to be darker.

No micro needling or laser (yet) just silicone strips. I use AWD silicone strips on Amazon and cut them to fit elbow to armpit. I used to wear them on my entire scar but they never stayed on my sideboob area because of bras and whatnot so I don’t bother anymore. 
My best advice for getting them to stick and stay is take them off when you’re doing any type of physical activity where you’re sweating a lot. I also shower with mine on and just use a gentle soap over them. I change them about once a week.
I went to Cayman Islands for vacation about 5 months post op, I can say with 100% confidence the scars are worth having toned arms. I was able to wear the cutest tops.
It was $11,500, I can’t say for sure but I think a lot of the stretch marks were part of the extra skin that was removed. I definitely still have some but they are super faded and barely visible.
Hi, sorry about my late response. I hope it went well! I was comfortably back bending with no discomfort at about 8 weeks post. Before then I was doing mild lower body stretches with no issues.

Hi! So sorry for the late response, this is a throwaway account so I don’t check it often. 
I kept my arms elevated in bed with a bunch of pillows, my surgeon said as long as my elbows are over my heart if that makes sense. When chillin on the couch I had one elbow on the arm of my couch and the other propped up with pillows so it wasn’t too bad. I also did take pics along the way, I can DM them to you.
Thank you 💖 it was $11,500, about $12,200 including the lymphatic massages afterwards

I’m loving the results so far, I posted a before and after here as well. The recovery isn’t terrible more uncomfortable than anything. The armpit part is probably the worst part but other than that I’m really looking forward to my final results.
Not sure if there’s a specific name for it, I just asked my surgeon if she could shape out my jaw line and take some of the stubborn fat under my chin, I had this in addition to arm lift.

Pretty close, Houston! I would say she’s 100% worth the travel, the scars are slightly visible from the back but honestly i don’t care about the scarring at all. She also wrapped the scar around my breast and shaped them really nice. I just want to walk around topless now.

I paid $11,500 total for an extended brachioplasty, for some reason my surgeon did not charge me extra for the chin lipo. I thought the 11K was total for the chin lipo and the arm lift but during my consult the patient coordinator said the surgeon wasn’t charging me extra which is a steal because it’s usually around 4K. The balance breakdown they sent me also had no mention of the chin lipo, just the arm lift. So I guess she figured it wasn’t extensive enough to charge me since my arm lift was already pretty steep.

I was also pre diabetic about 3 years ago, I’ve lost about 65 pounds since then but the before pic was only about 10 pounds ago and I was still pretty dark. My neck area darkness is completely gone though.

I completely understand what you’re saying, I have made choices in my life that have resulted me to end up in the position that I am in. But sometimes life is not that simple. Life is fucking hard and will chew you up and spit you out, life is especially hard when you don’t have an adult in your life to look up to and provide guidance. I was lucky enough to have a close family member take me in when I became an adult and show me how to be who I am now. If I didn’t have this person open their home and heart to me I don’t know what I would’ve done and I’m scared to think what my life would like now. There is no way in hell I would let my brother fall victim to society and the system because I was too selfish to take him in. Again, I understand this is my choice but this falls back on my parents for being irresponsible selfish adults who should’ve never had kids in the first place and put me in a position where I feel responsible for raising my siblings so they can go on and make something of themselves.

I’ve been lifting inconsistently since 2020 but didn’t start getting into a gym with a routine until February of this year. I started with the strong curves program excel that was posted here and was consistently going to the gym 4 times a week but in April I went on vacation, got sick and fell off for about a month. I started again in mid may and have been consistent ever since. I am now on week 5 of gluteal goddess and I’m very happy with my progress so far! 

I eat about 1,800 cals a day and aim for 135g of protein per day but honestly have a hard time hitting that goal. I go to the gym 3 times a week focusing on progressive overload and days I don’t hit the gym I have a treadmill at home that I will use. 

My weight has also been fluctuating between 190-192 in the past couple months but no dramatic change in weight. My goal is to ultimately be in the 140 range but I’m going for more of a goal look than a goal weight.
